comments.issue: Direct UserDefaults access creates tight coupling and makes testing impossible without mocking UserDefaults
comments.suggestion: Inject a StorageProtocol dependency. In production use CacheManager, in tests use MockStorage.

comments.issue: Calendar.current is called inline — timezone logic is untestable
comments.suggestion: Inject a DateProvider protocol that wraps Calendar. Tests can provide fixed dates.

blocking_issues: Maintainability at 2: tight coupling to UserDefaults and Calendar makes testing fragile and changes risky
